hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook with only the afterInitialize permission bit set; the afterInitialize callback is a no-op stub. The contract also exposes an initializePools() function that calls an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper to bootstrap liquidity and records the resulting tick. The hook does not affect swap or liquidity-modification execution in any way.
